title: boehmeria zollingeriana var. latifolia
intro: Boehmeria zollingeriana var. latifolia, commonly known as Longstalk Nettle, is a plant species belonging to the Urticaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Longstalk Nettle are primarily attributed to its ability to exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential use in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Boehmeria zollingeriana var. latifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal activities.
